description:
Join the Spells of Love affiliate community and partner with an award-winning demi-fine jewellery brand celebrated for its timeless everyday luxury. Crafted in vermeil, sterling silver and solid gold, our small-batch collections combine exceptional craftsmanship with ethical and eco-conscious practices.

From natural gemstone and pearl jewellery to personalised pieces, Spells of Love has been featured in Vogue, Elle and Harper’s Bazaar, and worn by renowned names including The Princess of Wales, Kendall Jenner and Maya Jama.

We’re seeking passionate creators who align with our brand and want to share beautifully crafted jewellery with their audience while becoming part of an exclusive and growing community.


How Affiliates Can Earn
Earn 10% commission on every successful referral sale through your unique affiliate link. With a 30-day cookie, you can receive rewards even if your referral purchases days after first clicking your link. It’s a simple way to turn your influence into tangible rewards while sharing jewellery you love.

How to Promote Us
Promote Spells of Love jewellery in ways that resonate with your audience:

  • Share your favourite pieces on social media or your blog.
  • Create style guides, gift guides, or jewellery lookbooks.
  • Highlight personalised and gemstone pieces for special occasions.
  • Leverage video content to showcase the quality and craftsmanship of our collections.

Become a Spells of Love affiliate and start earning while sharing jewellery that your audience will adore.
payout_period: Payout is on the last day of each month.

Spells of Love Affiliate & Ambassador Program Terms & Conditions


Last Updated: May 2026


Welcome to the Spells of Love Affiliate & Ambassador Program. By applying to or participating in our Program, you agree to comply with the following Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully before joining.

Throughout these Terms, “Spells of Love”, “we”, “us”, or “our” refers to Spells of Love, and “affiliate”, “ambassador”, or “you” refers to any individual participating in the Program.

By participating in the Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms & Conditions in full.


1. Eligibility

  • Be at least 18 years old.
  • Have a public Instagram, TikTok, or other approved social media account.
  • Provide accurate and up-to-date personal and payment information.
  • Have a genuine interest in and enthusiasm for the Spells of Love brand and products.
  • We welcome creators of all sizes and do not require a minimum follower count.


2. Approval of Applications


All applications are reviewed individually. Spells of Love reserves the right to approve or reject any application at our sole discretion and without obligation to provide a reason. Submission of an application does not guarantee acceptance into the Program.


3. Affiliate Links & Discount Codes


Once accepted, you may receive a unique affiliate tracking link and/or personalised discount code. Commissions are tracked through your assigned link and/or code.

If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent valid referral link used before purchase will determine commission attribution. If a customer uses both your affiliate link and discount code, only one commission will apply. Affiliates may only promote discount codes specifically assigned to them.


4. Commission Structure & Payments

Affiliates and ambassadors earn commission on qualifying sales made through their affiliate link or approved discount code. Commission rates, payment schedules and payout thresholds are displayed within the affiliate dashboard and may be updated at Spells of Love's discretion.


Payment Terms


  • Commission is calculated on the order subtotal excluding shipping fees, VAT, taxes, duties, gift cards, refunds, chargebacks and any non-qualifying purchases.


  • Commission is only payable on completed, qualifying orders.


  • Commission is not earned until an order has been fulfilled and shipped. Orders awaiting fulfilment, including pre-orders and delayed dispatches, remain pending and do not qualify for payment until they have been shipped and all applicable holding periods have been satisfied.


  • Commission becomes eligible for payment 30 days after an order has been shipped, rather than when the order is placed.


  • Due to order processing, dispatch and shipping times, commission payments may take up to 35 days from the date the order is placed, provided the minimum payout threshold has been met.


  • Minimum payout threshold: £10.


  • Payments are made via PayPal unless otherwise agreed.


  • You are responsible for ensuring your payment details are accurate and up to date.


  • Orders that are cancelled, refunded, exchanged, disputed, subject to a chargeback, fraudulent, or otherwise fail to meet the requirements of the Program will not qualify for commission and any unpaid commission may be reversed or withheld.


  • Spells of Love reserves the right to withhold, adjust or refuse commission payments where fraudulent, misleading or abusive activity is suspected.


Discount Codes & Commission Attribution


Orders placed using promotional discount codes may result in a reduced commission rate or no commission being paid, depending on the promotion applied. Spells of Love reserves the right to adjust commission payouts where significant discounts, sitewide sales, gifted orders or promotional offers have been applied. Commission eligibility and commission rates are determined at Spells of Love's sole discretion and may vary during promotional periods.


Pre-Order Items


  • Commission for pre-order products will not become payable until 30 days after the pre-order item has been shipped, regardless of when the original order was placed.


  • Where an order contains both in-stock and pre-order items shipped separately, commission relating to the pre-order item(s) will only become payable 30 days after those item(s) have been dispatched.


  • For the avoidance of doubt, commission is only earned on products once they have been fulfilled and shipped. Estimated shipping dates for pre-order items do not create any entitlement to commission until the item has been dispatched and all applicable holding periods have elapsed.


  • If a pre-order is cancelled, refunded, exchanged, disputed, subject to a chargeback, found to be fraudulent, or otherwise does not result in a completed qualifying sale, no commission will be payable.


  • Spells of Love reserves the right to withhold, adjust or decline commission where an order is cancelled, refunded, returned, exchanged, found to be fraudulent, or otherwise fails to meet the requirements of the Affiliate & Ambassador Program.


5. Cookie Tracking


The Program operates using a 30-day affiliate tracking cookie. If customers disable cookies, clear cookies, switch devices or otherwise interrupt tracking, Spells of Love cannot guarantee commission attribution.


6. Content & Promotional Guidelines


Affiliates must create original content, use only approved assets where permitted, avoid misleading or harmful content, and comply with any request from Spells of Love to remove content inconsistent with brand values.


7. Gifting & Ambassador Expectations


Ambassadors receiving gifted products are expected to create agreed promotional content within a reasonable timeframe. Failure to do so may result in removal from the Program and an invoice for the full retail value of gifted products.


8. Use of User-Generated Content (UGC)

By participating, you grant Spells of Love a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use your content for marketing. You retain ownership of your original content. Contact hello@spellsoflove.co.uk if you would prefer specific content not be reused.


9. Brand Assets & Intellectual Property

All brand assets remain the intellectual property of Spells of Love and may only be used to promote the brand. Permission is limited, non-exclusive and revocable.


10. Prohibited Activities


Fraud, self-referrals, misleading advertising, keyword bidding, impersonation, unauthorised discount codes, fake orders, tracking manipulation or promotion alongside illegal or harmful content may result in immediate removal and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.


11. Term & Termination


Either party may terminate participation. Pending valid commissions may still be paid subject to these Terms. Contact: hello@spellsoflove.co.uk.


12. Limitation of Liability


Spells of Love shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages arising from the Program and makes no guarantee of uninterrupted service, tracking accuracy or earnings.


13. Changes to These Terms


Spells of Love may amend these Terms at any time. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.


14. Contact


If you have any questions regarding the Affiliate & Ambassador Program, please contact hello@spellsoflove.co.uk.
